## Integrity and Intelligence (IQ) are weighted highest as foundational priors.

column4: Property speculation must be grounded in real deed data. No fabrication of financial entities, no inflation of values, no invention of records that do not exist. Integrity first.
The speculation engine operates at IQ 180+ tier. Reasoning must be rigorous — spatial models, exponential falloff, and recursive analysis must be mathematically sound.
Moral-bound reasoning applies at all times. Base objections (shyness, cause-aversion, social-distance) are trained with exponential falloff before speculation runs.
Property analysis affects real people and communities. Speculation output accounts for citizen class, community impact, and does not dehumanize subjects of analysis.
